newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Jan-April PSBR 42.0 trillion lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy Jan-April PSBR 42.0 trillion lire.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was around 42.0 trillion lire at end-April 1997 compared with 71.673 trillion at end-April 1996, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.
The statement, dated May 2 and made available on Tuesday, said the April public sector deficit was around 18.0 trillion lire, more than 7.3 trillion lower than in April 1996.
The statement gave no further data but said the figures were worked out in accordance with a new means of defining data approved by the European Union's statistics body Eurostat in March.

Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi told parliament on Monday that he expected the deficit in the first six months of 1997 to be less than half that of the first six months of 1996, when the PSBR was 53.75 trillion lire under the Eurostat definition.
